answer_1.quote: We apply the concept of controlled neural text generation to the domain of argument generation. Our Arg-CTRL is conditioned on topics, stances, and aspects and can reliably create arguments using these control codes.
answer_1.outputs: single-sentence argumentative statements (pro, con, or counter‑arguments) generated conditioned on topic, stance and aspect

answer_2.quote: Both the retrieval and generation approaches are evaluated against reference data ... via METEOR and ROUGE-L metrics.

answer_4.quote: We conduct an expert evaluation on a subset of generated arguments with two researchers ... Two aspects are evaluated: fluency and persuasiveness.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators judged each generated sentence for fluency (binary grammatical correctness) and compared pairs of generated and reference arguments for persuasiveness.
